Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by mixed economic signals. Weak jobs data might ease rate hike pressure, but a Fed official still advocates for increases, and a major chip name (AMD) sank despite beating earnings. This creates headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-45.03%) and SPAL (-47.87%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay over time and their drops are amplified by your margin use. SMH (-9.53%) is also down in the chip sector.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further Fed commentary regarding interest rates and any broader market reactions to the weak jobs report. Also, monitor the chip sector for continued weakness after AMD's move.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged positions and stay highly alert to rate hike signals and sector-specific weakness.
plays: SOXL is a "SELL" at -45.03% and leveraged. Consider trimming this position to reduce high-risk exposure and manage decay.
SPAL is "NEW" at -47.87% and leveraged. Review its stop at 21.38; this deep loss on a new, volatile ETF needs immediate attention.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market signals are mixed, and managing existing leveraged positions is the priority.
